subject: Invitation to Exclusive Wine Tasting Event
body: Dear valued customer, You are cordially invited to an exclusive wine tasting event at our downtown location this Friday from 6-8pm. Join us for an evening of exquisite wines, delicious hors d'oeuvres, and live music. Please RSVP by replying to this email by Wednesday. We look forward to seeing you there! Cheers, The Wine Emporium Team
